WITH counts_by_type AS (
  SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM orders AS o
  INNER JOIN riskandmargin AS r
    ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.ordertune
), type_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(order_count) AS average_count
  FROM counts_by_type
)
SELECT AVG(c.order_count) AS average_count,
       AVG(c.order_count - a.average_count) AS average_excess
FROM counts_by_type AS c
CROSS JOIN type_average AS a
WHERE c.order_count > a.average_count;
